jobs.title: Social Comms
jobs.description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public. You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work. You'd be a great fit if You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious. You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have. You've run or grown popular social accounts before. You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you. You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about. You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included. You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time. You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits. Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks. jobs.title: Why do you want this new job
jobs.description: No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far: Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years. Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance. Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss. Iâm looking for more challenging work. All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills. About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer. If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job. About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job. Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it. In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description: The project compensation rate is $0.55 USD per accepted image. The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes: • Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings. • Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation. • Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes. To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project. Qualification path No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, written communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of driving alignment and outcomes across teams you do not manage. Commerce, e-commerce, point-of-sale, or marketplace experience. Hands-on experience with workflow, case-management, or process-automation platforms. SQL, business-intelligence tools, or data modelling. Experience evaluating or deploying AI-enabled solutions for operational use cases. Experience driving adoption and effectiveness after launch, not just delivery. We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: 🌎 What we do Root is Europe’s #1 primary data collection platform for F&B companies. We help our customers to measure and reduce farm-level emissions. ~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator. Enterprises are mandated by regulatory bodies to disclose their climate performance, which leads to increasing pressure from investors, competitors, retailers, and consumers to prevent and reduce their CO2e emissions. Over the next 10 years, companies have set ambitious reduction targets that need to be met. Unlike other industries, the vast majority of F&B emissions originate from farms (known as Scope 3.1 emissions) and are highly complex to address. Root exists to help overcome this challenge. We raised >€10m in funding in the first 2 years of our existence, we launched our enterprise product, signed and onboarded some of the largest F&B players in Europe, and put together what we believe is the best-suited early-stage tech team in Europe. Will you be the next to join us? 🚀 🔭 What you will work on Your mission Drive customer success by supporting a customer portfolio, ensuring smooth project execution and tool adoption, and helping build strong, trust-based relationships that maximize long-term value and advocacy. 📅 Over the next months, you will… Drive Customer Success and Long-Term Value for Root's Customers Own the success of a defined customer portfolio , acting as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor, guiding customers through key success milestones (onboarding, data collection, verification, reporting, reduction readiness) and ensuring they clearly understand and realize the value of the Root Platform Plan, manage, and execute customer projects end-to-end , driving primary data coverage at scale through increased user engagement and data completion, serving as the first point of contact for agricultural users when needed, and ensuring high data quality, clear milestones, and on-time delivery Design and run farmer-facing enablement , including digital webinars to drive participation, improve data quality, and build trust at the farm level Collaborate with Account Management to relay customer feedback while building trust-based customer relationships that drive long-term satisfaction, retention, and advocacy Collaborate with Product to bring agricultural and agronomic expertise into our products, translating practical farming knowledge and farmer needs into actionable product feedback and clear, farmer-facing recommendations. 🧺 What you bring along Agricultural background (practical farm experience, agricultural studies, or prior work with agricultural users such as advisors, cooperatives) Hands-on and detail-oriented, you thrive in fast-changing, early-stage environments, can juggle multiple tasks, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks First experience in Customer Success, Operations or other fast-paced environments, where you supported or executed customer-facing processes end-to-end People-centric and proactive, empathetic, approachable, and able to communicate clearly while keeping customer outcomes and business priorities in mind Comfortable working with data in Excel and digital platforms, with an eye for completeness and consistency Fluent in German and English; additional languages (Polish, French, Portuguese, Spanish) are a plus Work from our Berlin office 5 days a week 🤗 You don't feel like you fulfill all the criteria? We get it: confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But guess what?! There is no such thing as a “perfect” candidate. The only thing you need to ensure along the recruiting process and beyond is that the problem that we are solving with Root is one you cannot wait to get out of bed for on Monday morning! jobs.title: Senior Customer Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Empower every employee. Flip ist die führende KI-gestützte Employee Experience Platform für Frontline Worker. Wir revolutionieren, wie die Menschen arbeiten, die die Welt am Laufen halten- in Retail, Manufacturing und Logistics. Eine App. Ein Touch. Alles, was sie brauchen. Unsere Mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch. Stellenbeschreibung Hunderttausende Menschen, die nicht am Schreibtisch arbeiten, öffnen Flip, um alles zu erreichen, was die digitale Welt ihres Unternehmens für sie bereithält. Unteranderem gehören Bosch, REWE und Porsche zu den Unternehmen, die damit arbeiten. Der schwierige Teil ist die letzte Meile in eine über Jahrzehnte gewachsene Enterprise-IT und genau diese letzte Meile ist diese Rolle. Als Customer Engineer arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen unserem Produkt und der Umgebung unserer Kund:innen: ihrem Identity-Stack, ihren HR-Systemen, ihrem Security Review, ihrer KI-Roadmap. Du bringst einen Flip-Tenant von null auf Hunderttausende aktive Nutzende und entscheidest, wie die technische Seite gelöst wird. Manchmal, indem du die Integration designst und die IT auf Kundenseite in die Lage versetzt, sie selbst zu bauen, manchmal, indem du die erste Version selbst baust und sie anschließend übergibst. Dazu gehört der Teil, an dem unsere KI beim Kunden live geht: Agents in der App, Tool-Zugriff über MCP und die Authentifizierungsfragen darunter, die bisher niemand gelöst hat. Das erwartet dich bei uns Technische Verantwortung von Anfang bis Ende: Du verantwortest die technische Seite unserer Enterprise-Onboardings, vom ersten Architekturgespräch bis zum stabilen Rollout in der Breite. Integrationen, die Flip tragfähig machen: Du designst und lieferst Identity und Authentifizierung (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), SCIM-Provisioning, REST-APIs und Anbindungen an HR- und operative Systeme wie SAP SuccessFactors, Workday oder UKG. Beraten und befähigen statt selbst abarbeiten: Du führst die IT auf Kundenseite, ihre Partner und unsere externen Entwicklungspartner zu einer Lösung, die du selbst unterschreiben würdest, und sorgst dafür, dass sie ohne dich betrieben werden kann. Bauen, wo es den Rollout löst: Wo Bauen der schnellste Weg ist, einen Ansatz zu belegen oder ein Rollout wieder in Bewegung zu bringen, baust du die erste Version und übergibst sie danach sauber, mit Dokumentation und Übergabegespräch, damit sie Bestand hat. KI dort, wo sie auf den Kunden trifft: Du gestaltest, wie Agents, Tool-Zugriff über MCP und Agent-to-Agent-Szenarien in echten Enterprise-Umgebungen ankommen, inklusive der Auth- und Datengrenzen, die dabei halten müssen. Technische Autorität im Account: Du stimmst Anforderungen mit Projektleitung, IT, Security, Fachbereichen und Betriebsräten ab, entscheidest die technischen Fragen und gibst die Lücken, die du dabei siehst, an unser Produkt- und Engineering-Team zurück. Rechne mit regelmäßigen Reisen zu Kund:innen, etwa 10 bis 30 Prozent deiner Zeit. Das bringst du mit Must-haves Rund 3 bis 5 Jahre (oder mehr) in der IT- oder Tech-Beratung, im Customer Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering oder in der SaaS-Implementierung, mit echter Enterprise-Erfahrung. Praktische Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Integration und Identity: SSO und Authentifizierung (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID oder vergleichbar), REST-APIs und API-basierte Integrationen, die du in echten Enterprise-IT-Landschaften geliefert hast. Technische Verantwortung am Kunden in Enterprise-Projekten, in denen du die technischen Entscheidungen gemeinsam mit IT, Security und Fachbereichen getroffen und nicht nur koordiniert hast. Echte technische Tiefe, ohne in Vollzeit Produktcode zu schreiben: Du liest Code, prüfst ein Design, debuggst eine Integration und baust einen funktionierenden Prototypen. Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher und fließendes Englisch. Nice-to-haves Erfahrung mit SCIM-Provisioning und Anbindungen an HR- oder Workforce-Systeme wie SAP SuccessFactors, Workday o

jobs.title: Senior Customer Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Empower every employee. At Flip, we have a clear goal: to revolutionize the world for frontline workers and give them a voice. Become a Flip Game Changer and work with an unbeatable team to ensure that all employees, no matter where they work, have access to their company's internal information. If you're ready to make an impact and shape the work lives of millions of people, then you've come to the right place! Our Mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch. Job Description Flip is the frontline employee experience platform. Hundreds of thousands of people who do not work at a desk open Flip to reach everything their employer's digital world holds for them and Bosch, REWE and Porsche are a a few of the companies that run it. The hard part is the last mile into a decades-old enterprise IT landscape, and that last mile is this role. As a Customer Engineer you sit on the edge of the product, inside the customer's environment: their identity stack, their HR systems, their security review, their AI roadmap. You take a Flip tenant from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. That includes where our AI goes live: agents in the frontline app, tool access over MCP, and the authentication questions underneath them that nobody has solved yet. What you can expect Technical ownership end to end: You own the technical side of enterprise onboardings, from the first architecture conversation to a stable live rollout at scale. Integrations that make Flip load-bearing: You design and land identity and authentication (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), user provisioning (SCIM), REST APIs and connections into HR and ops systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG. Advise and enable instead of absorb: You bring the customer's IT, their partners and our external development partners to a solution you would sign off on, and you make sure they can run it without you. Build where building unblocks: Where building is the fastest way to prove an approach or to unblock a rollout, you build the first version and then hand it over cleanly, with the documentation and the handover conversation that make it stick. AI where it meets the customer: You lead how agents, MCP-based tool access and agent-to-agent scenarios land at enterprise customers, including the auth and data boundaries that have to hold around them. Technical authority in the account: You work with customer project management, IT, security, functional departments and works councils, you decide the technical questions, and you feed the gaps you see back into our product and engineering teams. Expect regular travel to customer sites, roughly 10 to 30 percent of your time. What you bring to the table Must-haves Around 3 to 5 (or more) years in IT or tech consulting, customer engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or SaaS implementation, with real enterprise exposure. Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and identity: SSO and authentication (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID or comparable), REST APIs and API-based integrations delivered inside real enterprise IT environments. Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them. Genuine technical depth without being a full-time production developer: you read code, review a design, debug an integration and build a working prototype. German at C1 level or above and fluent English. Nice-to-haves Provisioning experience (SCIM) and integrations into HR or workforce systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG. An informed, current view on where agentic AI is heading: MCP, A2A, EMA and the authentication questions underneath them. We are looking fo

jobs.title: Werkstudent (w/m/d) Business Development
jobs.description: Holzprofi24 ist Marktführer im eCommerce für Home & Garden im DACH-Raum. Wir skalierten unser Geschäft konsequent über eine AI-driven und tech-fokussierte Infrastruktur. jobs.title: Werkstudent - Technisches Projektmanagement
jobs.description: In the following you'll find information about us and the specific role: Ort: Berlin Kreuzberg, vor Ort Umfang: 20 h/Woche, flexibel einteilbar Vergütung : 17–20 €/h Arbeitssprache: Deutsch Start: ab sofort Was wir lösen Die Energiewende ist relevanter denn je: Solaranlagen, Wärmepumpen und Wallboxen werden in Deutschland so schnell gebaut wie noch nie. Aber es gibt eine Bremse, die kaum jemand kennt - Bürokratie . Was heißt das konkret? Jede einzelne Anlage muss beim Netzbetreiber angemeldet werden, bevor sie laufen darf. Klingt einfach? Ist es nicht: In Deutschland gibt es über 850 Netzbetreiber - jeder mit eigenen Formularen, eigenen Prozessen, eigener Auslegung der Regeln. Kein Standard. Für Installationsbetriebe heißt das drei bis vier Stunden pro Anlage , in denen ein Handwerker Formulare ausfüllt statt zu bauen. Wir lösen das mit Software. Unsere Plattform erzeugt die Unterlagen aus den Daten des Installateurs und reicht sie automatisiert beim richtigen Netzbetreiber ein. Unter unseren Kunden sind die größten Player der Solar- und Wärmepumpenbranche in Europa. Und weil dieses Problem den Installationsbetrieben so weh tut, konnten wir im letzten Jahr von null auf über 1 Mio. € Umsatz gewachsen - bootstrapped, profitabel und ohne Investorengeld. Deine Rolle Du arbeitest im operativen Kern unseres Produkts und trägst Ownership für einen ganzen Bereich . Dort sorgst du dafür, dass alles sauber durchläuft: Du behandelst die Edge Cases, kommunizierst mit allen relevanten Stakeholdern und betreust den Prozess so, dass er nicht nur jede Woche besser wird, sondern dass wir jede Woche mehr Kunden bedienen können. Denn genau da stehen wir: Mehr Kunden wollen unser Produkt, als wir heute live nehmen können. Prozessbetreuung: Dein Bereich läuft, weil du ihn steuerst - von der Anmeldung bis zur Bestätigung durch den Netzbetreiber, inklusive der technischen Abstimmung, wenn etwas nicht passt. Expansion: Du hilfst dabei, den Rollout in neue Netzbetreibergebiete voranzutreiben - neue Regeln erschließen, im System abbilden, live bringen. Und damit neue Kunden. Produkt: Wenn etwas hakt oder du einen Impuls hast, baust du mit unserem Engineering-Team direkt die Lösung. Du gestaltest das Produkt aktiv mit - und skalierst damit unser Operations-Geschäft. Was du mitbringst Du studierst Ingenieurwissenschaften: Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik, Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Ähnliches Du arbeitest dich schnell in unbekannte Themen Du treibst gerne eigene Bereiche voran, statt auf Anweisungen zu warten Ausgeprägtes Auge fürs Detail - du findest Fehler, die nicht auffallen Du bist in Berlin und kannst 20 h/Woche im Büro sein Von Netzanmeldungen musst du noch nie gehört haben. Das lernst du hier in zwei Wochen. Warum Voltir Mission: Netzanmeldung ist einer der größten Engpässe der deutschen Energiewende. Du bist dabei, ihn zu lösen. Wir leben AI-First: Ganze Bereiche wie Finance oder Go-to-Market sind bei uns One-Person-Teams, weil eine Person mit den richtigen Tools, Working Mode und Automatisierung sie trägt. Du lernst hier, wie das geht und bekommst Werkzeug und Wissen an die Hand, um es dir selbst anzueignen. Im heutigen Arbeitsmarkt ist das unglaublich viel wert. Ein Startup, das durch die Decke geht: Du erlebst direkt mit, wie ein Unternehmen richtig groß wird. Von Fehlern zu gemeinsamen Meilensteinen, du sammelst echte Startup-Erfahrung. Domain-Wissen, das du sonst nirgendwo bekommst: Netzbetreiber-Prozesse, Marktstammdatenregister, VDE-Normen, die Arbeitsweise der größten Solar- und Wärmepumpen-Anbieter Europas - du siehst den Renewable-Energy-Markt von innen. jobs.title: Head of Product Development & Engineering (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Stellenbeschreibung Wir machen wenige Modelle in großen Stückzahlen — jeder Millimeter am Leisten, im Fußbett und in der Konstruktion multipliziert sich hunderttausendfach. Aus diesem Grund muss der Schuh perfekt sitzen. Du baust Produkte nach der Pammys Bibel. Bisher entwickeln wir eng mit Partnern. Jetzt bauen wir die technische Produktentwicklung im eigenen Haus auf: eigene Leisten- und Passform-Standards, eigene Komfort-Technologien, ein eigenes Entwicklungsteam. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest den kompletten Entwicklungsprozess: Brief → Tech-Pack → Proto-Runden → Sales Samples → Sealed Sample → Serienanlauf (Tooling-Trials, PPS, TOP). Jedes technische Gate auf diesem Weg liegt bei dir — inklusive der Freigabe, mit der ein Modell in Serie geht. Du baust dein Team auf und führst es: Footwear Development, Leisten & Passform (Last & Fit), Tooling, Commercialisation und Materials — in der Reihenfolge, die das Wachstum verlangt. Du etablierst Leisten und Passform als Kernkompetenz: eigene Leisten-Bibliothek, Passform-Standards, Grading — bei Comfort-Schuhen ist der Leisten das Produkt. Du entwickelst unsere eigenen Komfort-Technologien für Fußbett und Sohle — gemeinsam mit starken Material- und Compound-Partnern. Du verankerst Wear-Tests sowie Prüf- und Compliance-Standards (SATRA/ISO, REACH, Produktsicherheit für den EU-Markt) im Entwicklungsprozess. Du arbeitest im festen Dreier-Team mit Produktmanagement und Design: Du machst Entwürfe baubar, ohne sie kleinzumachen. Du stimmst dich eng mit unserem Sourcing ab — zu Machbarkeit, Werkzeugen und Serienanlauf. Dein Profil Langjährige Erfahrung in der Footwear-Produktentwicklung (typischerweise 10+ Jahre), davon mehrere Jahre fabrikseitig in Asien — im Sample Room, nicht nur im Videocall. Ideal: Erfahrung mit Comfort-Produkten oder EVA (Spritzguss, Formteile) — alternativ Athletic Footwear mit echter Tooling-Tiefe. Führungserfahrung: Du hast Entwicklungsteams geführt und einen T&A-Kalender über mehrere Modelle parallel gehalten. Solides Handwerk in FOB-Kalkulation, Tooling-Ökonomie und Materialkunde. Verhandlungssicheres Englisch und Reisebereitschaft. Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Du baust die technische Produktentwicklung von Grund auf auf: Statt bestehende Strukturen nur zu verwalten, definierst du unsere Standards für Leisten, Passform, Komfort, Tooling und Commercialisation selbst. Echter Einfluss auf das Produkt: Deine Entscheidungen bestimmen unmittelbar, wie unsere Schuhe sitzen, funktionieren und sich im Alltag anfühlen. Große Stückzahlen, große Wirkung: Wir entwickeln bewusst wenige Modelle mit hohem Volumen. Technische Verbesserungen, die du entwickelst, wirken sich direkt auf hunderttausende Produkte aus. Du entwickelst eigene Technologien: Gemeinsam mit starken Partnern entwickelst du eigene Komfortlösungen für Fußbett, Materialien und Sohlenkonstruktionen, statt lediglich bestehende Lösungen einzukaufen. Du stellst dein eigenes Team zusammen: Du entscheidest mit, welche Kompetenzen wir wann intern aufbauen und entwickelst daraus eine leistungsstarke Footwear-Development-Organisation. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Product, Design und Sourcing: Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und keine langen Konzernschleifen zwischen Entwicklung, Design und Produktion. Nähe zu den Foundern: Du arbeitest eng mit den Entscheidungsträgern zusammen und kannst technische Produktentscheidungen direkt auf höchster Ebene beeinflussen. Internationales Produktionsumfeld: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktions-, Material- und Tooling-Partnern in Asien zusammen und bist dort, wo die Produkte tatsächlich entstehen. Hoher Qualitätsanspruch statt schneller Kompromisse: Bei Pammys ist Passform kein Detail. Du bekommst den Raum, Standards aufzubauen, mit denen unsere Produkte technisch und qualitativ langfristig besser werden. Wachstum mit Verantwortung: Mit neuen Modellen, Kategorien und höheren Volumen wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich und damit die Möglichkeit, eine zentrale Produkt

jobs.description: Stellenbeschreibung Pammys ist in wenigen Jahren auf über 1,3 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Jetzt bauen wir die Product Organisation für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase: neue Kategorien, höhere Volumen, internationale Märkte und ein global skalierbares Produktionsnetzwerk. Dafür suchen wir einen Chief Product Officer (m/w/d), der unsere gesamte Product Organisation aufbaut, führt und auf das nächste Level bringt. Wir suchen keinen CPO, der Produkt nur aus Strategie-Meetings kennt. Wir suchen einen Builder und Operator, der weiß, wie man Product Development, Engineering, Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, Production, Quality und Product Marketing zu einer leistungsfähigen Organisation verbindet. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Gründern unsere langfristige Produkt- und Kategoriestrategie und verantwortest gleichzeitig, dass diese operativ funktioniert. Wenn ein Development-Prozess nicht funktioniert, gehst du rein. Wenn Qualität, Costing oder Timelines nicht stimmen, willst du verstehen warum und löst das Problem gemeinsam mit deinem Team. Wenn entscheidende Kompetenzen fehlen, baust du sie auf. Ein zentraler Bestandteil deiner Rolle ist der Aufbau unserer internationalen Product- und Sourcing-Struktur in China und perspektivisch weiteren Produktionsmärkten wie Vietnam. Dein Ziel ist klar: Bessere Produkte. Schnellere Entwicklungszyklen. Höhere Qualität. Stärkere Margen. Klare Ownership. Eine Product Organisation, die mit Pammys skalieren kann. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung zentraler Unternehmensbereiche und entwickelst Strukturen, Verantwortlichkeiten, Prozesse und Führung konsequent weiter. Du baust leistungsfähige Teams und Funktionen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette auf – von Strategie und Entwicklung über Beschaffung und Produktion bis hin zu Vermarktung und kommerzieller Steuerung. Du rekrutierst, führst und entwickelst starke Führungskräfte und Spezialisten und schaffst eine Organisation, die eigenständig, klar strukturiert und skalierbar arbeitet. Gemeinsam mit den Gründern entwickelst du die langfristige Unternehmens- und Wachstumsstrategie und übersetzt sie in klare Prioritäten, Strukturen und operative Maßnahmen. Du stellst sicher, dass strategische Initiativen von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung effizient, bereichsübergreifend und ergebnisorientiert gesteuert werden. Du optimierst Prozesse mit dem Ziel, Entscheidungswege zu verkürzen, Komplexität zu reduzieren und die Organisation schneller und leistungsfähiger zu machen. Du entwickelst unser internationales Partner-, Produktions- und Lieferantennetzwerk weiter und führst strategische Verhandlungen zu Kosten, Kapazitäten, Qualität, Zeitplänen und Rahmenbedingungen. Du baust gemeinsam mit uns unsere internationale Präsenz, insbesondere in China, weiter aus und entwickelst dort langfristig ein leistungsfähiges lokales Team. Du etablierst klare Qualitäts-, Steuerungs- und Kontrollmechanismen und stellst sicher, dass vereinbarte Standards im Tagesgeschäft konsequent umgesetzt werden. Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit den relevanten Teams die kommerzielle Steuerung zentraler Geschäftsbereiche – einschließlich Kosten, Preisen, Margen, Mengen, Zeitplänen und Profitabilität. Du schaffst klare Verantwortlichkeiten und stellst sicher, dass wichtige Initiativen über alle beteiligten Funktionen hinweg konsequent vorangetrieben werden. Du verknüpfst Strategie und operative Umsetzung eng mit Kundenbedürfnissen, Marktkenntnissen und kommerziellem Potenzial. Du arbeitest regelmäßig direkt mit unseren internationalen Teams und Partnern zusammen und steigst bei kritischen Themen auch selbst tief in operative Fragestellungen ein. Dein Profil Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung auf Director-, VP-, SVP- oder C-Level im Product-Bereich einer Footwear Brand oder eines vergleichbaren internationalen Consumer-Unternehmens. Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung einer multidisziplinären Product Organisation. Tiefge

Over the past 6 years, our People team has designed, built, and implemented the people processes that have scaled Street Group from 30 - 230 people. But we know that systems that work at 150 people can break at 300 - and we want to get ahead of that. This is an opportunity for someone who has been through that scaling journey before to have an oversized impact on a small but ambitious People team to become best in class. jobs.description: About Us Parity is one of the world's most experienced core blockchain infrastructure companies, having built and pioneered some of the most advanced technologies in the blockchain sector. Parity was founded by Dr. Gavin Wood, co-founder and former CTO of Ethereum, the primary engineer behind the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), inventor of the Solidity programming language, and primary author of the Ethereum Yellowpaper. People in Our Collective Are Highly motivated to contribute to Parity’s mission and be part of something bigger Excited to work on projects that are groundbreaking and complex Autonomous workers that self-initiate, but also collaborate well with others Taking maximum accountability and having minimum ego at work Comfortable with chaos and adapting to the ever-changing Web3 space Continuously educating themselves about Parity and the wider ecosystem About the Team The SRE team is responsible for the infrastructure that makes the Polkadot platform and technology work: test and production network environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and the systems that developers, node operators, and end-user applications across the ecosystem rely on. This spans the full stack from runtime and parachain development environments through to infrastructure supporting live applications and events. We run environments at different stability tiers, from fast-moving test networks with daily automated updates to production networks with 24/7 on-call coverage. It's a small team, so the role carries broad scope. The Role We're looking for an engineering manager who can lead a team of experienced SRE engineers and raise the standard of what reliability looks like in a blockchain infrastructure context. The team is technically capable. What it needs is someone who can set engineering direction, build the conditions for good work, and think clearly about reliability as a discipline: SLOs, error budgets, blameless postmortems. What We're Looking For Systems thinking. You have a genuine understanding of distributed systems and large-scale infrastructure. You don't need to be the most senior engineer technically, but you need to be credible to people who are. Reliability. You've worked in or led a team that takes SRE seriously. You have a track record of engineers growing under your leadership, ideally some of them moving on to bigger things. Comfort with unusual territory. Blockchain infrastructure has properties that don't map cleanly onto standard cloud operations. You don't need prior Web3 experience, but you shouldn't be put off by it either. jobs.title: Operations Lead
jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region, including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role The Operations Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale. This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks. What You'll Own Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market. Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless. Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability. Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed. Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases. Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies. What We're Looking For Strong background in operations, execution, or internal business operations in tech, fintech, or fast-scaling environments. Proven experience leading operations and admin teams in high-expectation environments. Hands-on mindset with the ability to solve problems directly, not just delegate them. Strong organisational, execution, and problem-solving skills. Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving situations. Ability to work cross-functionally and drive execution without formal authority. This Role Is Not For People who want to direct operations from a distance instead of stepping in when things break. Candidates who need fully-built systems and processes handed to them. Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines. People who avoid escalations, messy cases, or hard conversations with vendors and staff. People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions. Location This role is based in the United Kingdom . This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Role Overview Harvey’s in‑house legal team is a global group of lawyers and legal professionals operating across multiple disciplines. In this role you will collaborate closely with legal colleagues in the commercial team and our sales/ Go-To-Market team, advise the engineering and product teams to ensure that our business practices adhere to privacy laws and regulations globally, and partner closely with the security function to safeguard and maintain the integrity of our data. jobs.title: SRE Manager
jobs.description: About Us Parity is one of the world's most experienced core blockchain infrastructure companies, having built and pioneered some of the most advanced technologies in the blockchain sector. Parity was founded by Dr. Gavin Wood, co-founder and former CTO of Ethereum, the primary engineer behind the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), inventor of the Solidity programming language, and primary author of the Ethereum Yellowpaper. People in Our Collective Are Highly motivated to contribute to Parity’s mission and be part of something bigger Excited to work on projects that are groundbreaking and complex Autonomous workers that self-initiate, but also collaborate well with others Taking maximum accountability and having minimum ego at work Comfortable with chaos and adapting to the ever-changing Web3 space Continuously educating themselves about Parity and the wider ecosystem About the Team The SRE team is responsible for the infrastructure that makes the Polkadot platform and technology work: test and production network environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and the systems that developers, node operators, and end-user applications across the ecosystem rely on. This spans the full stack from runtime and parachain development environments through to infrastructure supporting live applications and events. We run environments at different stability tiers, from fast-moving test networks with daily automated updates to production networks with 24/7 on-call coverage. It's a small team, so the role carries broad scope. The Role We're looking for an engineering manager who can lead a team of experienced SRE engineers and raise the standard of what reliability looks like in a blockchain infrastructure context. The team is technically capable. What it needs is someone who can set engineering direction, build the conditions for good work, and think clearly about reliability as a discipline: SLOs, error budgets, blameless postmortems. What We're Looking For Systems thinking. You have a genuine understanding of distributed systems and large-scale infrastructure. You don't need to be the most senior engineer technically, but you need to be credible to people who are. Reliability. You've worked in or led a team that takes SRE seriously. You know what error budgets are actually for, when SLOs are miscalibrated, and how to run postmortems that improve things. Automation. You get uncomfortable when skilled engineers spend time on work a machine could do. You've built teams that automate away the repetitive work rather than just absorbing it. People development. You have a track record of engineers growing under your leadership, ideally some of them moving on to bigger things. Comfort with unusual territory. Blockchain infrastructure has properties that don't map cleanly onto standard cloud operations. You don't need prior Web3 experience, but you shouldn't be put off by it either. Working at Parity Remote-first, with offices in Berlin, Lisbon, and London. Parity is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome. View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data. You will work closely with seven Salesforce specialists and a Product Manager to deliver against team objectives. Our team works fluently with Visual Studio Code, Git, and SFDX CI/CD, and has recently adopted AI-assisted development to significantly increase output. We deploy to production an average of three times per day. Our guiding philosophy is "Salesforce flows first." Most business features are built by administrators using Flow. While Salesforce is the primary tool for our Sales and Care teams, Angi's core platform runs on services built in Symfony 5.4 (PHP 8.1) and Kotlin, deployed on Kubernetes clusters. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data. At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day. Mission As an Account Executive , you will win new food distributor customers across the French market, owning the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed agreement and helping them modernize their operations with Choco’s technology. What you'll do Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through product demos, negotiation, and close. Build your own pipeline through cold outreach, referrals, industry events, field visits, and existing networks. Run compelling demos of Choco’s products, including our AI-powered solutions, connecting what we build directly to the problems our customers need to solve. Lead effective commercial conversations, understand how a distributor operates, identify their biggest challenges, and build a clear case for change. Manage diverse sales cycles, from agile, family-run food suppliers to complex, multi-stakeholder organizations. You must adeptly pivot your strategy, balancing relationship-building with high-touch, consultative selling to drive consensus and close deals across varying business structures. Help improve how we sell by sharing what you learn from customers, testing new approaches, and contributing to the team’s playbook. Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to ensure a seamless transition for new clients and to provide feedback on market needs for scaling SMB and Mid Market relationships. What you bring 3+ years of experience in software sales, ideally progressing from SDR/BDR into an Account Executive role, with hands-on experience owning and closing deals. A track record of consistently overachieving against sales quotas and targets. Consistent achievement of self-sourced pipeline generation and outbound activity targets. Experience managing a full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close. A strong track record of outbound prospecting and creating your own pipeline. Comfortable working in a fast-paced sales environment, managing multiple opportunities and maintaining momentum across your pipeline. Fluency in French and English (C1+) Proven ability to manage mid-market sales cycles with a focus on value-based selling and long-term partnership growth. Demonstrated experience in cross-functional collaboration, working with internal teams to deliver complex solutions to sophisticated business customers. What you get Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets. Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins. Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end. In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office). jobs.title: Product Manager - Discover
jobs.description: About BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely. Your Mission As the Product Manager for the Discover squad, you will focus on the upper funnel of the passenger journey. Your mission is to capture global traffic via SEO and emerging LLM-based search (GEO), ensuring passengers have a seamless experience when they land on our platform. You will build a vision that maximizes conversion from all acquisition channels, prioritizing high-impact projects across our core markets. The Team The Demand Team: The Discover squad is a core team of the Demand pillar, owning the end-to-end passenger experience alongside Search, Booking, Payment, and Post-booking. Your Squad: You will co-lead the Discover squad alongside an Engineering Manager. The squad consists of 6 front-end engineers. Internal Stakeholders: Product Marketing, SEO and Digital Marketing Managers, Product Data, Product Design, and Business leads. Your Responsibilities Shape the Discover strategy & roadmap: Define the Product and Engineering vision for the Discover scope, along with the appropriate KPIs to measure progress. You will take full responsibility for your scope from strategy to execution. Drive top-funnel acquisition: Partner with the Marketing and SEO teams to define and deliver the acquisition roadmap. This includes adapting our architecture for the AI era to ensure our inventory is easily crawlable by LLMs and AI agents. Maximize landing page conversion: Define and deliver a strategy to optimize the landing experience and maximize conversion from all channels. You will leverage AB tests to run experiments and drive our Land-to-Book conversion targets. Navigate cross-functional alignment: Act as the go-to product person for all Discover topics. Communicate the strategy, formalize major decisions, and ensure alignment across Engineering, Marketing, Design, Data, and Business teams. Manage the Busfor platform: Act as the referent Product Manager for Busfor, a standalone brand acquired and owned by BlaBlaCar operating in Eastern Europe Your Qualifications Experience: 3+ years of Product Management. An experience in top-of-funnel acquisition, growth, or SEO is preferred but not required. Problem-Solving: Highly analytical with a proven track record of using A/B testing to deliver fast, incremental impact on conversion rates. Stakeholder Influence: Strong interpersonal skills to navigate cross-functional relationships, gain buy-in, and clearly communicate prioritization decisions. Languages: Full fluency in English is mandatory. If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application! jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Enterprise
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h3 class="mt-3 -mb-1 text-[1.125rem] font-bold">À propos du poste</h3> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">En tant qu'ingénieur·e en IA appliquée au sein de notre équipe Entreprise, votre rôle est de guider certaines des plus grandes entreprises de France vers la frontière de l'IA et de les aider à déployer Claude dans leurs opérations, leurs produits et leurs méthodes de travail. Vous deviendrez le·la spécialiste incontournable de la plateforme Claude et le·la conseiller·ère technique de confiance de vos clients, en conseillant leurs équipes d'ingénierie sur l'architecture, la conception d'agents et l'évaluation, et en travaillant avec les dirigeants et les cadres supérieurs qui sponsorisent ces programmes pour démontrer la valeur ajoutée de Claude et les aider à prendre une décision éclairée quant à l'adoption de Claude.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">Les transactions avec les entreprises sont différentes. Les cycles d'approvisionnement sont plus longs, davantage de parties prenantes sont impliquées, et la réussite dépend de la capacité à relier le travail technique aux résultats qui importent pour le conseil d'administration. Vous serez tout aussi à l'aise pour conseiller une équipe d'ingénierie sur l'évaluation et l'architecture que pour présenter un dossier de valeur à un CIO ou un CTO, et vous porterez le fil technique à travers chaque étape d'un engagement s'étalant sur plusieurs trimestres.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">Une grande partie de ce travail se déroule en français, avec des cadres dirigeants et des équipes d'ingénierie françaises, c'est pourquoi un français natif ou courant est essentiel pour ce poste. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de comptes Entreprise et les architectes IA appliquée pour accompagner chaque client depuis la première conversation, à travers l'évaluation technique, la création de valeur et les achats, jusqu'à la décision de développer sur Claude. Une fois leur décision prise, vous préparerez leur partenaire d'intégration système à assurer la mise en œuvre, en définissant ensemble l'architecture cible et les critères de réussite, et vous resterez proche du client en tant que conseiller·ère technique sur Claude pendant tout le déploiement, tandis que le partenaire se chargera de la construction. En travaillant aux côtés des équipes Produit et Ingénierie d'Anthropic, vous mettrez à profit votre connaissance de la plateforme Claude pour conseiller sur l'évaluation, recommander des architectures répondant aux exigences de sécurité et d'échelle des entreprises, et créer les ressources techniques et commerciales qui aident les grandes organisations à réussir avec Claude.</p> <h3 class="mt-3 -mb-1 text-[1.125rem] font-bold">Responsabilités</h3> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3 print:block print:space-y-1"> <li class="font-claude-response-body whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Travailler en partenariat avec les responsables de comptes et les architectes en IA appliquée pour accompagner les clients entreprises en France

And beyond. ⭐️ The Business Segment Lead role ⭐️ At Alan, we split the French market in several business segments, each of them corresponding to a category of clients (whether by size, or industry). The role of a Business Segment Lead is to reach market leadership in their given segment. To succeed, you will have to (1) articulate a vision for your segment, (2) define priorities and resources to deliver, and (3) make strategic decisions for your segment based on market insights. The Business Segment Lead role is made for transversal influence as we operate based on distributed ownership. You will work closely with all teams involved in the success of your segment (Product, Insurance, Sales, Marketing). You will also collaborate with other segment leaders to build-up knowledge, share best practices, and create alignment around a long-term value plan. Main missions include: Market intelligence: You’ll build expertise on our market and competitive landscape. You’ll work both on the quantitative side (sizing) and the qualitative side (customers’ pain points and needs). Value proposition and pricing : Our goal is to differentiate our offer from the market. You’ll relentlessly ask yourself: what is the best product offering to become leader in this segment? Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). This will require you to adapt and innovate when it comes to distribution channels, sub-segments, and partners management. P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L. Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights. We are currently hiring for new segments: It gathers several, high potential sub-segments where everything is to be built. We will focus heavily on those new opportunities in the coming years. ⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️ At least 8 years of prior experience leading a business (product category, business segment, etc.) Full working proficiency in French At least advanced level in English An exceptional ability to establish transversal influence Used to analyze and manipulate data to build a 360 degree view of your market A strong business sense while being able to go deep into product considerations Able to articulate clear strategies in spite of complexity/uncertainty A prior experience working with senior leadership You are a generalist self-starter (Vs a specialist of 1 single industry) able to adapt fast and not afraid to go on the field to support your team mates and learn from them You are based in (or willing to relocate to) either Paris, Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelon

That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.</p> <p>When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.</p> <p>The hard part is deciding what good enough means. You will own projects end to end: find where a process is failing or create toil, prove it with data, design something better, coordinate the build with stakeholders, and stay with it until the receiving team owns it and the numbers have moved. Design : turn what you find into clear requirements, better flows, and delivery plans with measurable success criteria, then build or coordinate the automation, tooling, data, and controls they depend on. Instrument : lead testing and launch readiness, track impact against agreed measures, drive adoption, and hand ownership back to the team that owns the outcome. Establish how we use AI agents in operations: identify where they create real leverage, then design, test, and deploy them for bounded, multi-step workflows, including the evaluation methods that prove they work. Partner with teams outside operations whose work affects these outcomes, and turn operational findings into business cases that help Product and Technology prioritize longer-term solutions. What you need to bring: We're looking for a candidate who has experience with the following: 7+ years in business analysis, process improvement, operations, implementation, or product operations. A track record leading complex cross-functional projects from problem definition through implementation and ongoing measurement. Strong analytical skills - you use data, queries, and dashboards to validate problems and prove outcomes, not only to report on them. Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, process designs, and delivery plans. Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, written communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of driving alignment and outcomes across teams you do not manage. Even better if you have, but not necessary: Financial services, fintech, payments, lending, or insurance - or another complex, regulated operating environment. Commerce, e-commerce, point-of-sale, or marketplace experience. Hands-on experience with workflow, case-management, or process-automation platforms. SQL, business-intelligence tools, or data modelling. Experience evaluating or deploying AI-enabled solutions for operational use cases. Experience driving adoption and effectiveness after launch, not just delivery. We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try! Flexible paid time off and remote work policies Equity options, because this is your company too Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters Training opportunities to grow your skills and career Health and wellness credit so you feel your best Time off

You will own projects end to end: find where a process is failing or create toil, prove it with data, design something better, coordinate the build with stakeholders, and stay with it until the receiving team owns it and the numbers have moved. AI is a default tool in how we work rather than a separate initiative. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with full ownership of your projects. What you’ll be doing: Define : map end-to-end flows, trace handoffs, and understand how a process actually runs rather than how it is documented. Diagnose : separate root causes from symptoms and quantify where time, money, and customers are being lost. Design : turn what you find into clear requirements, better flows, and delivery plans with measurable success criteria, then build or coordinate the automation, tooling, data, and controls they depend on. Instrument : lead testing and launch readiness, track impact against agreed measures, drive adoption, and hand ownership back to the team that owns the outcome. Establish how we use AI agents in operations: identify where they create real leverage, then design, test, and deploy them for bounded, multi-step workflows, including the evaluation methods that prove they work. Partner with teams outside operations whose work affects these outcomes, and turn operational findings into business cases that help Product and Technology prioritize longer-term solutions. What you need to bring: We're looking for a candidate who has experience with the following: 7+ years in business analysis, process improvement, operations, implementation, or product operations. A track record leading complex cross-functional projects from problem definition through implementation and ongoing measurement. Strong analytical skills - you use data, queries, and dashboards to validate problems and prove outcomes, not only to report on them. Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, process designs, and delivery plans. Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, written communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of driving alignment and outcomes across teams you do not manage. Even better if you have, but not necessary: Financial services, fintech, payments, lending, or insurance - or another complex, regulated operating environment. Commerce, e-commerce, point-of-sale, or marketplace experience. Hands-on experience with workflow, case-management, or process-automation platforms. SQL, business-intelligence tools, or data modelling. Experience evaluating or deploying AI-enabled solutions for operational use cases. Experience driving adoption and effectiveness after launch, not just delivery. We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try! Be a changemaker You’ll enjoy: A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work A culture that celebrates performance The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard Career-defining opportunities Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled. Flexible paid time off and remote work policies Equity options, because this is your company too Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters Training opportunities to grow your skills and career Health and wellness credit so you feel your best Time off

jobs.description: Strategic Finance Manager — The Flex The Flex is creating the future of flexible accommodation. We operate and manage properties across multiple cities and countries, bringing together hospitality, technology and operational excellence to make renting a home as effortless as booking a hotel. As our international footprint expands, we are searching for an outstanding Strategic Finance Manager to help build the financial systems, controls and insights required to support a rapidly growing global business. This is far more than a conventional accounting position. You will work closely with our founders and leadership team, take ownership of essential financial processes, evaluate business performance and provide the insights that enable better decisions as we scale. Your Mission As Strategic Finance Manager, you will play a central role in The Flex’s financial operations. Your objective will be to give the business complete clarity over where its revenue comes from, how its money is spent, how each area is performing and where profitability can be improved. Your responsibilities will span accounting, financial analysis, management reporting, payment reconciliation, budgeting and business performance. You will have exposure to the entire organisation, collaborating directly with operations, revenue management, property teams and senior leadership. For an ambitious individual, this position offers a clear path toward becoming Head of Finance or, ultimately, moving into a CFO-track role as The Flex continues to grow. What You Will Own Lead and continuously strengthen our day-to-day financial controls and reporting, ensuring that every number shared with management is accurate, validated, complete and supported by reliable evidence. Identify repetitive and manual finance tasks, create more efficient processes and collaborate with our engineering teams to automate them. Reconcile payments from Airbnb, Booking.com , Expedia, direct reservations and other distribution partners, confirming that every expected payment is received correctly and on schedule. Reconcile bank accounts and incoming transactions, ensuring that funds are properly received and recorded while investigating and resolving discrepancies quickly. Monitor and manage accounts payable and accounts receivable. Review supplier invoices and expenses incurred across the company. Oversee statutory filings and corporate compliance requirements across several jurisdictions, making sure that all submissions are correct and completed within the required deadlines. Coordinate with external accountants, tax advisers, auditors and banking partners to maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely compliance. Assist with financial statements for landlords and property owners whenever required. Develop dashboards and reporting tools that provide management with real-time visibility into company performance. Evaluate financial results across individual properties, cities, countries and business units. Create and maintain company budgets, forecasts and financial models. Track cash flow and support management in planning future funding and capital needs. Detect financial risks, discrepancies and potential sources of revenue leakage. Review the company’s cost base and uncover opportunities to strengthen margins. Partner with operational teams to understand, control and reduce costs at property level. Contribute to financial due diligence for acquisitions, investments and expansion into new markets. Communicate financial findings, recommendations and actionable insights directly to the founders and management team. What We Are Looking For A highly analytical individual who is confident and comfortable working with numbers. Exceptional attention to detail and an uncompromising approach to financial accuracy. A strong understanding of accounting concepts and financial principles. The ability to work effectively with significant volumes of financial and operational data. Advanced profic

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organisation, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com 's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, deeply embedded with C-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build. This is part of a growing motion, and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments. Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our London office. About the Role Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com 's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes. You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption. This is an autonomous, high-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward-deployed engineering at monday.com . What You'll Do Strategic transformation. Embed with C-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end-to-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout. Outcome ownership. Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there. Build and ship. Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself. Eval-driven product feedback. Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim. Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion. jobs.title: Senior Post Producer
jobs.description: About WPP Production We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world. About WPP WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit  WPP.com . A Hybrid working model We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around 4 days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. What does a Senior Post Producer do at WPP Production? You'll play a central role in delivering high-quality post-production projects across edit, grade, VFX, motion, and sound. As a Senior Post Producer you will bridge hands-on production and leadership, managing key projects, supporting producers, and maintaining strong relationships with clients, agencies, and creative partners. You'll ensure projects run smoothly, budgets are met, and the creative standard remains high across everything that leaves the studio. You'll be someone who thrives on collaboration, solves problems calmly under pressure, and takes pride in delivering work that looks, sounds, and feels exceptional. The ideal candidate will have experience working with a global technology brand or demonstrate a strong drive and ambition to contribute to a high-calibre account.  Responsibilities Production Lead multiple post-production projects from brief to final delivery, managing timelines, budgets and workflows. Oversee offline, online, grade, VFX, motion graphics and audio, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to a high standard. Own production workflows, tracking progress, risks and budgets and keeping the Executive Producer informed. Proactively identify and resolve challenges, balancing creative, technical and commercial priorities. Manage global workflows across a centralised production hub and continuously improve ways of working. Explore and implement AI and emerging technologies to improve efficiency, quality and output. Clients & Collaboration Act as a senior point of contact for clients and agency partners throughout production. Lead client calls, reviews and presentations, building trusted relationships and managing expectations. Collaborate closely with creatives, artists, technical teams and senior production leads to deliver high-quality work. Support and mentor junior and mid-level producers, sharing best practice and fostering a collaborative team environment. Quality & Commercial Own the studio QC process, ensuring work meets brand, technical and delivery standards. Develop and implement robust QC workflows and best practices. Prepare budgets and estimates, maintaining accurate financial tracking and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency. Contribute to rate cards, templates and processes that strengthen production and commercial performance. Requirements Strong post-production experience across broadcast, digital and social. Senior-level experience managing complex, high-end campaigns from brief to delivery. Strong understanding of the full post-production pipeline, including edit, colour, online, VF

jobs.title: Senior Director, Organizational Transformation & Workforce Design
jobs.description: Smartly is looking for a Senior Director, Organizational Transformation & Workforce Design to help shape how our organization evolves as we scale globally and embed AI more deeply into how we work. Reporting to the Chief People Officer and working within the CHRO Office, you will partner with leaders across Smartly to translate business strategy into organizational structures, workforce models, leadership capabilities, and transformation programs that help our teams operate effectively at scale. What You Will Do Lead enterprise transformation initiatives across organizational design, leadership effectiveness, workforce evolution, new site and hub integration, and cross-functional operating models. Design how work evolves in an AI-enabled organization , partnering with leaders to rethink roles, workflows, team structures, and operating models as AI creates new opportunities to increase effectiveness and leverage. Build scalable workforce frameworks , including job architecture, career frameworks, and approaches that help Smartly make thoughtful decisions about how teams and capabilities should evolve. Strengthen leadership and manager capability by partnering with HR Business Partners and senior leaders to design leadership frameworks, manager development programs, and other scalable capability-building initiatives. Translate business priorities into transformation roadmaps , defining clear implementation plans, governance, measures of success, and approaches for driving sustainable adoption. Advise senior leaders on complex organizational challenges , bringing structured thinking and organizational expertise to decisions about structure, capabilities, ways of working, and change. Align stakeholders across functions and geographies , ensuring organizational changes are practical, clearly understood, and connected to measurable business outcomes. What We Are Looking For Strong experience leading organizational transformation, organizational design, workforce design, strategy, or related work, either within organizations or in management consulting. Deep understanding of organizational design and operating models, with experience translating business strategy into practical organizational solutions. Experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives and moving from strategy and design through implementation. Experience designing leadership, manager, or organizational capability programs that can scale across an organization. Ability to advise and influence executive stakeholders, navigate different perspectives, and build alignment around complex decisions. Strong structured problem-solving skills and the ability to turn ambiguous organizational challenges into clear frameworks and actions. Experience with change management and stakeholder engagement across teams, functions, and geographies. Curiosity about AI-enabled organizations and a practical perspective on how AI can reshape roles, workflows, team structures, and the future of work. What We Offer You At Smartly, we offer a place where you can advance your career. Here, you'll find: An Inclusive Global Culture: Join a team of over 750 Smartlies, representing more than 60 nationalities across 24 locations in 13 countries. Global Impact: Contribute to a company making a global impact, directly influencing our customers' success and business growth. Focus on Wellbeing: We prioritize your health with healthcare packages, mental health services, and a commitment to work-life balance through paid holidays and family leave. Comprehensive Rewards: Benefit from equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.
